known.via: English Wikipedia "Malvasia di Castelnuovo Don Bosco" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for sweet, sparkling red or rosé dessert wine from the province of Asti. It is made from Malvasia di Schierano, and tastes sweet and aromatic with some tannin.
